name: NoRawColorOutsidePrimitives
description: Raw hex/rgb/color values outside primitive/source tokens

name: NoArbitrarySpacing
description: Spacing must resolve to spacing tokens except documented exceptions

name: NoArbitraryRadius
description: Corner radius must resolve to shape tokens

name: NoArbitraryShadow
description: Shadow/elevation must resolve to elevation tokens

name: SingleIconFamily
description: Do not mix unrelated icon families in one shell

name: StableNavigation
description: Sibling screens preserve navigation anatomy and ordering

name: CTAHierarchy
description: Primary/secondary/tertiary actions have distinct hierarchy

name: StateCompleteness
description: Interactive components include applicable loading/empty/error/disabled/success states

name: FocusVisible
description: Keyboard focus is visible and not obscured

name: TargetSize
description: Pointer/touch target size/spacing meets configured accessibility profile

name: NoFakeData
description: No fake testimonials, customers, metrics, addresses or certifications presented as real

name: NoHorizontalOverflow
description: No unintended horizontal overflow at validation widths

name: ResponsiveIntent
description: Layout transformation is specified, not just scaled

name: ReferenceLock
description: Locked visual/reference values cannot drift without variance receipt

name: MotionReduced
description: Reduced-motion equivalent exists for nonessential motion

name: ContrastSemantic
description: Text/control/status pairs meet configured contrast gate

name: NoColorOnlyState
description: State meaning is not encoded by color alone

name: NoGiantGenericHero
description: Marketing hero must communicate product/service and next action quickly

name: LimitGradientText
description: Gradient text limited to one focal phrase unless reference lock requires more

name: LimitGlass
description: Glassmorphism restricted to justified overlays/navigation

name: LimitPills
description: Pill shapes used semantically, not as default container for everything

name: CardPurpose
description: Cards require meaningful grouping; avoid cardifying every region

name: ContentMeasure
description: Long-form line length is constrained for readability

name: ImageConsistency
description: Image family uses consistent crop/aspect/treatment

name: SkeletonGeometry
description: Skeletons approximate final component geometry

name: ErrorRecovery
description: Error states provide a recovery path

name: PreserveInput
description: Recoverable form errors preserve user input

name: DestructiveSeparation
description: Destructive actions are visually/structurally separated

name: LoadingShift
description: Loading strategy avoids avoidable layout shifts

name: DensityLock
description: Each surface region declares a density mode

name: ConsistencyRule31
description: Use semantic typography roles instead of one-off sizes

name: ConsistencyRule32
description: Use semantic border roles instead of one-off divider colors

name: ConsistencyRule33
description: Component variants must share anatomy

name: ConsistencyRule34
description: Avoid duplicate components with cosmetic-only differences

name: ConsistencyRule35
description: Persist selected state across responsive transformations

name: ConsistencyRule36
description: Every overlay defines dismissal and focus return

name: ConsistencyRule37
description: Every async action defines pending and retry behavior

name: ConsistencyRule38
description: Tables define narrow-screen transformation

name: ConsistencyRule39
description: Charts provide non-color distinctions and textual alternatives

name: ConsistencyRule40
description: Form validation maps messages to fields and summary where needed

name: ConsistencyRule41
description: Copy hierarchy follows content role tokens

name: ConsistencyRule42
description: Navigation labels use stable terminology

name: ConsistencyRule43
description: Buttons use verbs that match resulting action

name: ConsistencyRule44
description: Empty states distinguish zero-data from zero-results

name: ConsistencyRule45
description: Permissions states explain why access is needed

name: ConsistencyRule46
description: Offline state distinguishes unavailable from failed

name: ConsistencyRule47
description: Icon-only controls require accessible names

name: ConsistencyRule48
description: Sticky UI cannot obscure focused content

name: ConsistencyRule49
description: Safe-area insets are respected on edge-to-edge mobile layouts

name: ConsistencyRule50
description: Images declare responsive source/crop behavior

name: ConsistencyRule51
description: Long actions expose progress when meaningful

name: ConsistencyRule52
description: Success feedback is proportional to action importance

name: ConsistencyRule53
description: Modals are not used for routine multi-step tasks

name: ConsistencyRule54
description: Nested scrolling is avoided unless essential

name: ConsistencyRule55
description: Selection patterns are consistent across collections

name: ConsistencyRule56
description: Search keeps query visible when results change

name: ConsistencyRule57
description: Filter state remains inspectable and resettable

name: ConsistencyRule58
description: Responsive navigation preserves information architecture

name: ConsistencyRule59
description: Platform adapter owns system chrome conventions

name: ConsistencyRule60
description: Telemetry event names are stable across visual variants
